description: This file defines a React component for the 'Renewal' page, managing the state for user input, OTP verification steps, and displaying renewal results in a web application.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission to initiate email OTP sending and step transition.

methods.name: verifyEmail
methods.description: Verifies the email OTP, then proceeds to send phone OTP if successful.

methods.name: verifyPhone
methods.description: Verifies the phone OTP and completes the renewal process, displaying the result.
